'''Suribran Tu's palace''' was the building from which [[Suribran Tu]] led the people of [[Tibrin/Legends|Tibrin]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Tu was killed within the palace walls by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="Jedi: Count Dooku" />
